overview_description.description:
In its quest to develop new ways to fight cancer, aging, and inflammation, Alixia is engaged in medical research. The company utilizes integrate
biology, biophysics, computational chemistry, and clinical inputs to drive
new therapeutic innovations. The company's lead compounds focus on lead compounds that disrupt the metabolic and inflammatory triggers in both cancer and quasi-cancerous cells in the microenvironment.
